scope: Read-only actual Git objects, whole changed-tree Merkle comparison, complete previously accepted product/validation inventory binding and original v15 schema/code review before first branch publication. No Rust, Cargo, product workload, or guard process executed.

actual_api.message:
perf(index): reuse a bounded public-surface window within prepare

Reuse the actual initial query only when final seeds and admission bounds match; retain the original SQL fallback and epoch fences.
Add six focused controls alongside the three existing dependency controls and preserve a controls-only workflow.
Unreferenced product candidate; actual source approval and engineering execution remain separate.

docs(review): record independent approval of the prepare-local surface window

Bind all 1089 product inputs, 41 historical deltas and 139 validation inputs to the actual product commit. Preserve draft, formatter preparation and exact object review. No runtime or TODO acceptance is inferred.

chore(source): bind the reviewed surface-window candidate

Install only the exact product, independent review and registry pins. Keep verifier logic, original CI, six frozen v14 files and task definitions unchanged. The first actual controls and CI still have to execute on this fixed head.

tree_comparison.method: Recursively retrieve every changed or newly added tree with truncated=false; skip only exact (mode,type,OID)-equal entries. Compare full child-name union, so additions/deletions/mode changes cannot be hidden by compare endpoint file limits.

review_artifact_bodies.format: original Markdown design retained byte-for-byte under .json filename

verifier.code_review: Actual verifier body requires pinned registry SHA and identity, full independent review SHA/schema/source/base/scope/verdict/reviewers/no blockers, exact BASE→PRODUCT changed paths and before/after hashes, full reconstructed product set/body equality, complete validation inventory/current bytes, previous historical proof, six frozen files and original CI text. The new values satisfy the same data contracts; runtime proof execution remains required.

nonblocking_format_observation.meaning: The filename extension does not describe its retained original content. It is supporting evidence, not the canonical review or registry, and is not parsed by v15.
nonblocking_format_observation.audit_attempt_history: An initial audit-only loop assumed all eight supporting artifacts were JSON and raised SyntaxError on the original Markdown design. The corrected loop classified this fixed blob by its actual Markdown prefix and re-read/hashed all eight. No repository/source/artifact mutation or acceptance gate was changed.
